market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.7m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela at ~988k-1.2m bpd in early 2026; reaching 1.7m bpd would require nearly doubling output in 8 months. CFR and EIA assessments say boosting Venezuelan output requires years and billions in investment. Effectively a tail event.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Highly unlikely sanctions reversal + Chevron-like surge would still take time.
